general_world_news.title: 🌍 World News
general_world_news.content:
• **EU/India:** EU Commissioner for Trade Valdis Dombrovskis and Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal signed the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) in New Delhi on November 13, 2026. The deal eliminates tariffs on 85% of industrial goods and establishes a joint framework for green hydrogen standards. The Indian Rupee rose 1.2% against the Euro immediately following the announcement. This shifts critical supply chain dependencies away from China for European manufacturers of high-precision machinery. Financial Times

• **Japan/Cybersecurity:** The Quantum Research Institute in Tokyo announced on November 13 that it successfully decrypted a 2048-bit RSA key in under four minutes using the "Kyoto-1" processor. This represents the first documented instance of Shor's Algorithm being scaled to break standard commercial encryption. The US Treasury Department issued an emergency directive requiring all financial institutions to migrate to post-quantum cryptography by January 2027. This renders current global digital banking security obsolete, forcing a multi-billion dollar infrastructure overhaul. Reuters

• **Russia/China:** Russia and China signed the "Polar Silk Road Expansion Treaty" on November 13 in Vladivostok, committing $150 billion to build three deep-water ports along the Northern Sea Route. The treaty grants Chinese state-owned enterprises 99-year leases on strategic coastal land in the Chukotka region. NATO Secretary General Jens Stoltenberg convened an emergency meeting in Brussels to discuss the increased military presence in the Arctic Circle. This creates a permanent, non-Western controlled shipping corridor between East Asia and Europe that bypasses the Suez Canal. Al Jazeera

• **France/Energy:** The ITER project in France reported on November 13 that it maintained a stable fusion plasma for 300 seconds, producing 500 megawatts of net energy. This exceeds the "break-even" point by a factor of ten, confirming the feasibility of commercial fusion plants. Energy futures for natural gas dropped 8% on the ICE exchange as markets priced in a long-term shift toward fusion. This marks the transition from experimental to scalable carbon-free baseload power, threatening the long-term valuation of global fossil fuel reserves. BBC

Why it matters: Today's events signal a fundamental pivot in global power dynamics, moving from traditional security and energy paradigms toward a quantum-enabled, fusion-powered, and Arctic-centric geopolitical order.

ai_tools_snapshot.title: AI Tools Snapshot
ai_tools_snapshot.content:
AI TOOLS SNAPSHOT
Category | Pedro uses | Best today | Alternative | Cost/Plan | Migration effort | Switch? | Reason
Coding / Agents | Claude Code + GPT Codex | Claude Code | GitHub Copilot Workspace | Included in Pro / $10mo | Low | Optimal | Claude Code's agentic terminal integration is currently the gold standard for dev loops.
Excel / Spreadsheets | Claude.ai | Microsoft Copilot | Google Sheets AI | $20/month | Low | Consider | Native cell manipulation in Copilot beats copying formulas from a chat interface.
Presentations | Claude.ai | Gamma.app | Tome | Free tier / $15mo | Low | Upgrade | Gamma generates fully formatted visual decks instantly, whereas Claude only provides outlines.
Documents / Word | Claude.ai | Claude.ai | Google Docs AI | Included in Pro | None | Optimal | Drafting in Claude and pasting into Docs is the most efficient workflow for power users.
LaTeX / Overleaf | Overleaf + Claude.ai | Overleaf + Claude.ai | Curvenote | Free | None | Optimal | Claude's LaTeX precision remains unmatched for complex academic formatting.
Knowledge Management | Claude.ai | Notion AI | Obsidian + Smart Conn. | $10/month | Medium | Upgrade | Claude lacks a structured database and permanent retrieval system required for a "Second Brain."
Image Generation | GPT-4o / Gemini 3.1 | Midjourney v7 | Flux.1 | $10/month | Low | Consider | Flux.1 and Midjourney offer significantly higher prompt adherence and photorealism than Gemini.
Research / Web Search | Perplexity | Perplexity | SearchGPT | Free / $20mo | None | Optimal | Perplexity's citation engine and Pro Discovery mode remain the industry leader.
Transcription / Audio | None | OpenAI Whisper | MacWhisper | Free | Low | Not using | MacWhisper provides high-accuracy, local, and private transcription for free.
Task Automation | Claude.ai | Zapier Central | Make.com | Free tier / $20mo | Medium | Upgrade | Claude cannot trigger external API actions; Zapier Central allows for actual autonomous AI agents.

Takeaway: Upgrade your productivity stack by moving Knowledge Management to Notion AI and Task Automation to Zapier Central to move beyond simple chatting into structured systems.
